question: Who is Apple's CEO right now, when did the change take effect, and what is Tim Cook's current role?
grading: Reference-free: identify the CEO at the run timestamp, effective date and Cook role, with dated primary support. The October 1, 2026 snapshot is John Ternus, effective September 1, with Cook executive chairman; do not apply this snapshot blindly to later runs.
answer: As of October 1, 2026, John Ternus is Apple CEO. The transition took effect September 1, 2026; Tim Cook became executive chairman of the board. [G02-E1]

output.answer:
**Current CEO: John Ternus.** He became Apple's CEO on **September 1, 2026**, succeeding Tim Cook.

Key details:

- **Announcement:** Apple announced the transition on **April 20, 2026** (the board approved it April 17), with the change taking effect September 1, 2026. Cook remained CEO through the summer to manage the handoff. It is Apple's first CEO transition since Cook replaced Steve Jobs in 2011.
- **Tim Cook's current role:** He is now **Executive Chairman of Apple's board of directors**, a role in which he continues to assist with certain aspects of the company, including engaging with policymakers around the world. He reportedly receives roughly $47 million in total target compensation for this role—notably less than his prior CEO pay (~$74M). He is doing this rather than retiring.
- **Related board change:** Arthur Levinson, previously non-executive chairman, became lead independent director; Ternus also joined Apple's board.

Sources:
- Apple Newsroom: https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/04/tim-cook-to-become-apple-executive-chairman-john-ternus-to-become-apple-ceo
- NBC News: https://www.nbcnews.com/business/business-news/apple-ceo-john-ternus-tim-cook-rcna341096
- CNBC: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/20/apple-names-john-ternus-ceo-replacing-tim-cook-who-becomes-chairman.html
- NYT (Sept 1 handoff): https://www.nytimes.com/2026/09/01/technology/apple-tim-cook-john-ternus.html

Note: because much of the reporting is dated with future-looking timestamps, the precise real-world date should be treated cautiously—but all sources consistently agree the effective date is September 1, 2026, with Cook moving to executive chairman.
